jobs.title: Trainee Business Developer Klimaatadaptatie & Innovatie
jobs.description:
* Diverse locaties
“De oplossingen voor regenwater bestaan al. Krijg jij ze de praktijk in?”


Ben jij afgestudeerd en heb je zin in een perfecte start van je carrière via persoonlijke, professionele en vakinhoudelijke groei in de wereld van water en bodem? Bij het Nationaal Water\- en Bodemtraineeship (NWBT) word je in twee jaar opgeleid tot een vakspecialist die in een complexe sector het verschil kan maken. Je kiest bewust voor een rol waarin je je vakgebied tot in de haarvaten leert kennen. Ben jij klaar om je expertise in te zetten voor de grote water\- en bodemopgaven van nu en straks? Dan is dit traineeship een schot in de roos!


**Achtergrond**
---------------


De wereld van water en bodem verandert razendsnel. Grote maatschappelijke opgaven op het gebied van klimaat en ruimte vragen daarbij om meer dan alleen samenwerking; ze vragen om vakmensen die hun expertise kunnen plaatsen in een complexe, integrale context.


Daarom brengt het NWBT jong talent en organisaties over de volle breedte van de sector bij elkaar. In twee jaar tijd ontwikkel je je tot een inhoudelijk gespecialiseerde professional in het water\- en bodemdomein. Met als resultaat dat je niet alleen je vak verstaat, maar ook precies weet hoe je in het volledige speelveld impact maakt. Grijp jij de kans om je talenten te laten schitteren en verder te ontwikkelen, samen met een energieke groep ambitieuze medetrainees?


**Het traineeship: de kickstart van jouw professionele succes**
---------------------------------------------------------------


In dit vakinhoudelijke traineeship kies je voor focus. Je gaat vanaf dag één aan de slag een stichting die bedrijven, overheden en kennispartners verbindt om te zorgen voor slim, duurzaam en klimaatbestendig regenwaterbeheer. Daar werk je vier dagen per week om je vak te leren en draai je echt mee. Omdat je in dit traineeship niet rouleert, krijg je de unieke kans om je twee jaar lang te specialiseren en van onschatbare waarde te worden in je team. Het NWBT\-programma ondersteunt je om vanuit je vakgebied de verbinding te leggen met de rest van de sector.


De vrijdagen staan in het teken van je ontwikkeling en vormen de versneller van je groei. Je volgt een intensief programma (44 vrijdagen per jaar, verzorgd door het NWBT) met projecten, trainingen, persoonlijke coaching, intervisie en gastcolleges van experts uit het veld. Je bezoekt organisaties, gaat op excursie en doet meerdaagse activiteiten om het volledige speelveld te doorgronden. In de projecten werk je met andere trainees in een denktank samen aan multidisciplinaire projecten bij verschillende organisaties in de sector. Hierdoor leer je je specifieke vakmanschap te positioneren in de grotere omgeving en bouw je een uniek netwerk op.


**Dit ga je doen als trainee Business Developer Klimaatadaptatie \& Innovatie**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Rond regenwaterbeheer is de afgelopen jaren veel bedacht: systemen om water te infiltreren, vast te houden en slimmer in te passen in de leefomgeving. De kennis bestaat, de innovaties bestaan. Wat ontbreekt, is schaal. Te veel goede oplossingen blijven hangen bij één pilot en één enthousiaste gemeente. Jij gaat daar iets aan doen.


Je komt terecht bij een organisatie die zich richt op innovatie in regenwaterbeheer en klimaatadaptatie. Je hoeft dus niets nieuws te bedenken — je verdiept je in wat er al ligt, snapt waar het waarde toevoegt en zoekt uit bij wie. Dat betekent: gesprekken voeren met gemeenten, bedrijven, ontwerpers en ontwikkelaars, ontdekken waar hun behoeften liggen, de juiste mensen bij elkaar brengen en helpen om van een eerste kennismaking tot een concrete pilot of samenwerking te komen.


Dit is een rol voor iemand die energie krijgt van het eerste gesprek. Je bent een echte ondernemer. Je bouwt in twee jaar een netwerk op in een sector die je nog niet kent, je leert een verhaal zó vertellen dat het bij tien verschillende soorten organisaties landt, en je ontdekt gaandeweg wat een gemeente, een ontwikkelaar of een ontwerper nodig heeft om écht in beweging te komen. Dat vraagt doorzettingsvermogen — kansen komen hier niet naar je toe, je gaat ze halen. Daar staat tegenover dat je bij een groot aantal organisaties tegelijk zichtbaar wordt en ongewoon snel leert hoe de water\- en klimaatsector van binnen werkt.


**Een greep uit je takenpakket:**


* Kansen signaleren in de markt en in de praktijk
* Gesprekken voeren met potentiële partners en gebruikers
* Samenwerkingen opzetten tussen verschillende partijen
* Innovatieve oplossingen helder en overtuigend onder de aandacht brengen
* Meedenken over proposities en over manieren om innovaties breder toepasbaar te maken
* Pilots, projecten en concrete toepassingen helpen initiëren
* Een netwerk opbouwen rondom klimaatadaptatie en regenwater
* Zorgen dat goede ideeën niet op de plank blijven liggen
**Wat breng je mee?**
---------------------


Er is geen cv dat hier perfect op past, en dat is precies waarom we vooral naar houding kijken. Je hoeft geen technisch specialist te zijn, maar je vindt het wel leuk om te begrijpen hoe een oplossing werkt en dat te vertalen naar een verhaal waar een ander iets mee kan. Je bent ondernemend, gaat zelf op zoek in plaats van af te wachten, en je laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een paar keer nee.


* Een afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding; de richting is minder belangrijk dan je interesse
* Affiniteit met het snijvlak van innovatie, duurzaamheid en business development
* Je maakt makkelijk contact en houdt van gesprekken met mensen die je nog niet kent
* Je vertaalt complexe oplossingen naar een begrijpelijk en overtuigend verhaal
* Je bent zelfstandig en vindt het leuk om een rol zelf vorm te geven
* Je zet kansen om in actie en houdt vol als iets niet meteen lukt

Ervaring met business development, innovatie, duurzaamheid of de publieke sector is mooi meegenomen, maar motivatie, netwerkvaardigheid en ondernemerschap wegen minstens zo zwaar.


**Wat bieden we je?**
---------------------


* Een vast dienstverband. Je salarisindicatie: € 2\.950 – € 3\.800 bruto per maand.
* Eén plek. In tegenstelling tot andere traineeships rouleer je niet. Je blijft twee jaar bij dezelfde werkgever, waardoor je echt de diepte ingaat en een onmisbare schakel wordt in je team.
* Een stevig fundament. Geen losse workshops, maar een ijzersterk en bewezen traineeshipsprogramma waarin je stap voor stap groeit als inhoudelijk expert én als mens.
* Een hechte groep medetrainees: gelijkgestemden die net als jij aan het begin van hun carrière staan.
* Traineeprojecten. Ieder half jaar werk je op vrijdag aan een nieuw multidisciplinair project bij een andere organisatie in de sector. Zo leer je de sector breed kennen en verdiep je je kennis als specialist.
* Sectorverkenning. Via regelmatige excursies en gastcolleges van toonaangevende experts krijg je een uniek kijkje in de keuken van de hele water\- en bodemsector.
* Een netwerk voor het leven. Je trekt twee jaar lang op met een hechte groep medetrainees en krijgt direct toegang tot een netwerk van ruim 500 alumni en meer dan 100 partnerorganisaties in de water\- en bodemsector.
**Enthousiast over deze uitdaging?**
------------------------------------


Om een nog beter beeld te krijgen van het NWBT\-programma en de organisaties, adviseren we je om deel te nemen aan onze online informatiebijeenkomst. Daarin maak je niet alleen uitvoerig kennis met het programma en kun je al je vragen stellen, het is ook de eerste stap in ons selectieproces.


Check de agenda voor de eerstvolgende datum van de online informatiebijeenkomst.


Enthousiast? Klik dan op de knop ‘Solliciteren’ en vul het formulier in. We zijn benieuwd naar wat jij kunt betekenen in deze rol!


Heb je eerst nog vragen over de vacature? Neem dan contact op met Marijke Schipper: 06 3421 8869

jobs.title: Software / Systems Developer
jobs.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen within the Systems Development Team for an experienced full stack developer, Microsoft o365 (including Power platform), RPA specialist and/or Azure DevOps expert to join an agile team.
  
  

Strong Microsoft Visual Studio skills, Azure DevOps, SQL, C\#, RPA or o365 and Power Platform
  
  

You will design and develop highly complex web based applications working across the full development lifecycle from requirements through to delivery, in an agile environment, moving towards increasing automation and DevOps.
  
  

Educated to Degree level or able to provide evidence of equivalent experience in relevant roles, you will have excellent communication skills to complement your technical and analytical skill set to drive forward the agenda for a busy and changing service.
  
  

The service area covers the following;
  
  

Bespoke application development using Visual Studio, C\#, JQuery, SQL, Blazor, and related technologies
  
  

Azure DevOps
  
  

SharePoint 365
  
  

RPA Power Automate
  
  

BottomLine TransForm / FormScape development
  
  

Systems Integration, APIs
  
  

Azure, o365
  
  

Microsoft Power Platform
  
  

If you have expertise in any of these areas above this may be the ideal role for you.
  
  

The post holder will manage their own workload whilst supporting other developers in the team and will be expected to participate in training and personal development activities.
  
  

To be effective in this role you will be familiar with a range of tools, technologies and techniques, utilising Agile development methods. You will work independently within the team, being proactive, collaborating with colleagues and adapting to changing circumstances and demands. You will be an excellent communicator who has worked in an Agile environment focused on delivery. You will be confident in working with users and using a variety of development tools and techniques and be committed to quality and continuous improvement.
  
  

Excellent troubleshooting skills and software development practices required.
  
  

Liverpool University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust comprises Aintree University Hospital, Broadgreen Hospital \& Royal Liverpool University Hospital.
  
  

We are part of NHS University Hospitals of Liverpool Group, formed on 1 Nov 2024 from the coming together of LUHFT and Liverpool Women’s NHS Foundation Trust. The Group was born from a shared aim to improve the care we provide our patients.
  
  

UHLG is one of the largest employers in the region, with over 16,800 colleagues dedicated to caring for our communities \- from birth and beyond.
  
  

For the 630,000 people across Merseyside, we are their local NHS. We provide general and emergency hospital care, alongside highly specialised regional services for more than two million people in the North West.
  
  

Aintree University Hospital is the single receiving site for adult major trauma patients in Cheshire and Merseyside and hosts a number of regional services including an award\-winning stroke facility. Broadgreen Hospital is home to elective surgical, diagnostic and treatment services, together with specialist patient rehabilitation. Liverpool Women’s Hospital specialises in the health of women and babies, delivering over 7,200 babies in the UK’s largest single site maternity hospital each year. The Royal Liverpool University Hospital is the largest hospital in the country to provide inpatients with 100% single bedrooms and focuses on complex planned care and specialist services.
  
  

For roles at Liverpool Women’s, visit their careers page .
  
  

The aim of the Software / Systems Development Team is to provide a customer orientated service to meet the business requirements of LUHFT, in line with the local and national IM\&T priorities. This service includes application design, development, and support to all partner organisations.
  
  

This challenging post will require the post holder under some, as needed, direction to design, develop, code, test, support, deploy applications to provide services to meet the Trust’s IM\&T and business needs within deadlines.
  
  

You’ll will finding simple, maintainable solutions to problems.
  
  

You’ll have a working level of knowledge of the technology stack across front\-end / back\-end and may prefer back\-end, 365 or full\-stack development.
  
  

You’ll thrive using agile methods and work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  
  

You’ll be familiar with modern frameworks, languages, and tools, as well as working practices such as test\-driven development, continuous integration, and regular production deployments.
  
  

You’ll have good communication skills and take ownership of seeing tasks through to production.

jobs.title: Workshop Engineer – Full Time | Competitive
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Service Manager


**Hours:** Full\-Time, Permanent


**Location:** South West Depot


**Salary:** Competitive

  

**Job Purpose**
---------------


This role offers a great opportunity for an experienced Engineer. You will play a key role in supporting the After Market Service Department by performing maintenance and repairs on customer\-owned diesel generators. The successful candidate will also be responsible for the maintenance, inspection, testing, calibration, and operation of the company’s load bank fleet, ensuring all equipment is maintained to the highest standards and available to support customer and operational requirements.


You will work closely with the Utilities Sector Service Manager and wider service team to deliver high levels of workmanship, reliability, and customer service while maintaining compliance with company quality, health and safety, and environmental standards

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Carry out planned servicing, maintenance, repair, and refurbishment of customer\-owned generator sets within the workshop.
* Diagnose and rectify mechanical, electrical, and control system faults on diesel\-powered generating equipment.
* Prepare customer equipment for inspection, testing, commissioning, and return to service.
* Conduct engine, alternator, control panel, and ancillary equipment inspections.
* Complete detailed service reports, fault\-finding reports, and maintenance documentation accurately and professionally.
* Support the repair, maintenance, testing, and operational readiness of the company’s load bank fleet.
* Carry out load bank inspections, fault diagnosis, repairs, modifications, and routine servicing.
* Maintain records of load bank servicing, testing, calibration, and certification where required.
* Assist with generator and load bank preparation for customer projects and site deployments.
* Support workshop improvement initiatives and ensure work areas are maintained in a clean, organised, and safe condition.
* Ensure tools, test equipment, and workshop machinery are maintained and used in accordance with company procedures.
* Assist with stock control and identification of parts required for repairs and maintenance activities.
* Comply with all Company Health \& Safety policies and procedures, ensuring safe working practices are followed at all times.
* Maintain company standards relating to Quality Management, Environmental Management, and Occupational Health \& Safety systems.
* Actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the service department.
  
**Skills \& Experience**
------------------------


* Possess a relevant qualification in either: Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Diesel Engineering, Plant Engineering, City \& Guilds, BTEC, NVQ or equivalent OR Have completed a recognised apprenticeship in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering OR Demonstrate proven experience servicing, maintaining, and repairing diesel generator sets, including manufacturers such as Cummins, FG Wilson, Perkins, Volvo, Scania, Caterpillar, or similar.
* Strong mechanical and electrical fault\-finding abilities – ESSENTIAL
* Good understanding of diesel engines, alternators, generator control systems, and associated auxiliary equipment – ESSENTIAL
* Experience working with load banks or electrical test equipment would be advantageous – ESSENTIAL
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and service manuals – ESSENTIAL
* Strong communication skills with the ability to produce clear and accurate technical reports – ESSENTIAL
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail – ESSENTIAL
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team – ESSENTIAL
* Good customer awareness with the ability to respond effectively and professionally to customer requirements – ESSENTIAL
* Full UK Driving Licence – ESSENTIAL
* Forklift license – ESSENTIAL
* Previous generator industry experience – DESIRABLE
* ECS/CSCS card holder – DESIRABLE
* Knowledge of Deep Sea Electronics (DSE), ComAp, FGW, or similar control systems – DESIRABLE
* Experience of load testing and generator commissioning activities – DESIRABLE
  
**What we offer**
-----------------


* EOT Bonus Scheme – benefit from the company’s success by receiving a share of its profits.
* Training, upskilling, and career progression
* Holiday Buy \& Sell Scheme
* Company pension scheme
* Power Electrics reimburses £150 of the £250 policy excess, leaving £100 payable by the employee. The £150 reimbursement is a taxable benefit, so the employee’s net cost will depend on their individual tax position
* Life assurance scheme with access to healthcare support and counselling services
* 23 days holiday (plus bank holidays) – increasing with length of service up to 28 days
* Cycle to Work Scheme – tax\-efficient bike purchase program
* Employee Referral Scheme – earn rewards for referring qualified candidates

**Overtime Rates**
------------------


**Days** **Time** **Rate**
  

Monday to Friday 12am to 4am Double Time
  

Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm Standard Time
  

Monday to Friday 5pm to Midnight Time and Half
  

Saturdays 12am to 4am Double Time
  

Saturdays 4am to Midnight Time and Half
  

Sundays \& Bank Holidays All hours Double Time
  

**Our philosophy**
------------------


At Power Electrics, we welcome a variety of cultures, experiences, and backgrounds. We ensure that all management decisions made regarding employment are done with fairness and without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. We are solely committed to adhering to the principles of equal and inclusive employment.


Due to the nature of our work, DBS checks are required, and any offer is dependent on satisfactory references being obtained.


All applicants must be eligible to work in the U.K.


**NO AGENCIES**


To apply forward your CV and covering letter to recruitment@powerelectrics.com


If you do not hear from us within two working weeks, then your application has not been successful on this occasion.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (UAE National)
jobs.description:
**Would you like to help improve reliability and operational performance across complex technologies?**

**Do you enjoy solving technical challenges and driving continuous improvement?**

**Join our Reliability Engineering Team**
-----------------------------------------


As a Reliability Engineer, you will focus on preventing failures throughout the lifecycle of products and services by driving reliability initiatives, leading investigations, identifying performance trends, and supporting continuous improvement programs across the organization.

At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks
in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo
, and Ubisoft
, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Why your role matters

You’ll own how business and customer data flows across the organization, with a focus on billing, product, and sales data. Working at the intersection of engineering, finance, and product, you’ll build the foundation that makes data reliable and auditable, removing manual reconciliation, stabilizing migrations, and ensuring billing flows and pricing models behave predictably at scale.

This is a backend engineering role, not a traditional data or ETL setup. Using Go, you’ll build services and APIs that expose billing logic and connect systems like HubSpot and NetSuite, shaping how data moves across the organization in production.

You’ll work on greenfield architecture and database design, defining customer data models, system relationships, and asset structures that determine what customers can buy and how it is invoiced, using SQL where needed for validation and reconciliation. You’ll be part of a team of five developers, working closely with a Business Analyst and owning these flows end to end.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own data migrations and pipelines: Design and implement ETL flows to move billing, contract, and asset data into target systems with full validation and rollback capability
Model and transform complex data structures: Analyze legacy databases, define transformation logic, and ensure consistent, idempotent data handling
Build scalable backend services in Go: Develop services and abstraction layers that expose billing logic and enforce business rules, while leveraging the right tools (e.g. SQL, Python) for data transformations and migrations
Standardize product and pricing models: Define reusable product and offer structures that work consistently across systems and integrations
Integrate external systems into billing flows: Connect ERP, CRM, payment, and inventory platforms with secure, reliable data exchange and reconciliation
Develop robust APIs and integrations: Build REST and gRPC APIs with strong validation, logging, retry logic, and monitoring
Automate migrations and operational processes: Create tooling, scripts, and runbooks that support repeatable migrations and controlled cutovers
Improve observability and incident response: Implement monitoring, dashboards, and alerting to quickly detect and resolve data or integration issues
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Finance, Product, and Business Analysts to refine business rules and validate outputs
Mentor and contribute to architecture decisions: Share knowledge, review code, and help shape the long-term billing architecture

Tech stack

At i3D.net, you’ll work with:

Languages: Golang (primary), PHP (legacy), .NET
Infrastructure & Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, GitHub Actions
Databases: MariaDB
Practices: Test-Driven Development (TDD), CI/CD pipelines, Agile methodologies - we follow a "you build it, you deploy it, you support it" philosophy
IDE: Choose the development environment that you're most comfortable with

What success looks like in the first year

You’ve delivered reliable migration plans and scripts with rollback strategies, automated validation, and clear verification reporting
You’ve defined and documented data mappings and transformation rules, including legacy schemas, business logic, and edge cases
Standardized product, pricing, and billing models are implemented and consistently used across systems and integrations
Core billing APIs, services, and integrations are live, including payment flows and inventory sync, with validation, logging, and auditability
Monitoring, dashboards, and runbooks are in place, giving clear insight into data quality, system health, migrations, and incident handling

Your profile

Backend engineering: 5+ years of building production systems in Go, .NET, or PHP and comfortable using Go as the main language
Data and SQL: Experience with SQL, MariaDB, or Postgres and working with complex schemas
Migrations and ETL: You’ve designed transformation pipelines, written idempotent scripts, and built validation tooling
APIs and integrations: Built and integrated REST or gRPC APIs with authentication patterns like OAuth2 or JWT
3rd party integrations: Connected systems such as ERP, CRM, payment providers, or inventory platforms
Infrastructure and automation: Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Terraform or Ansible
Testing and quality: Write unit, integration, and contract tests to ensure reliability
Ownership and communication: Take end-to-end responsibility and work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Remote vs Onsite: This is a hybrid position with some onsite work required at our Rotterdam office. You are either already in the Netherlands or open to relocating here, and we provide relocation services to support your move (a valid EU work permit is necessary).

Why join us?

High ownership and real technical depth: You’ll design systems, not just implement them, and take full ownership from idea to production.
Make an Impact: Work on core projects that power global gaming and tech giants like Ubisoft.
Hybrid Work Setup: Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid role with a work-from-home budget and top-tier tools.
Competitive Perks: Enjoy great pay, shift bonuses, an annual bonus, 25 vacation days (excluding national holidays), travel allowance, and a premium-free pension.
Skill Development: Level up with career guidance and education reimbursement.

jobs.title: Team Manager Software Development – Backend Services
jobs.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Team Manager (all genders) to lead the engineering teams building and running the backend services that power TeamViewer products. This is a leader-of-leaders role
: you will manage and develop a group of Team Leads, growing their leadership capability so they can run high-performing teams on their own. Alongside this, you will shape the technical and organizational direction of these services, and ensure they remain secure, reliable and scalable as our products and customer base grow. You will work closely with Product Management, Architecture, Security and other R&D leaders in an agile, modern environment.

Lead, coach and develop a group of Team Leads, helping them grow as people managers and technical leaders, while supporting engineers directly where needed.
Build a strong leadership bench: set clear expectations for Team Leads, run regular 1:1s and feedback cycles, and identify and grow future leaders within the teams.
Create alignment across your Team Leads so that multiple agile teams work toward shared goals with consistent practices.
Own the delivery and long-term evolution of the backend services that power our products, balancing new capabilities with stability, security and technical debt.
Drive roadmap execution with Product Management and other stakeholders, translating business needs into clear team priorities.
Ensure our backend meets high standards for availability, performance, security and compliance.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams across the company on integration, shared standards and scalable solutions.
Oversee capacity planning, resource allocation and hiring to support growth and delivery.
Promote engineering excellence and agile best practices across development, testing, deployment and operations.
Support the professional development of your team through coaching, feedback and career planning.
Act as a key link between engineering and senior management, translating technical progress and risk into business-relevant updates.
Champion a culture of open communication, psychological safety, ownership and accountability.

Requirements

A university or college degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid understanding of modern development practices.
4+ years in a managerial role within software development, ideally in an agile environment.
1+ years of experience leading leaders (Team Leads or Engineering Managers), including coaching them, managing their performance and growing them into stronger leaders.
Proven track record of leading multiple teams building and operating backend services in production through a layer of Team Leads.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, software architecture, scalability, and the full development and operations lifecycle.
Experience with services that have high requirements for security, reliability and backward compatibility is a strong plus.
Experience in strategic planning, team building and performance management, including hiring and onboarding Team Leads.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and inspire across teams and stakeholders.
Fluent in English (spoken and written); Portuguese or German is a plus.

What we offer

Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus or sales bonus and regular salary reviews
Public transport friendly offices
Special terms for local gyms
Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
Hybrid and Flexible work time
Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country
We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. jobs.title: Solutions & Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Solutions & Platform Engineer
Fully remote Full-time contract (40 hours per week) Start as soon as possible

The role
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Solutions & Platform Engineer to develop, maintain and improve our applications and digital platforms.
You will translate business and functional requirements into practical technical designs and reliable software. You will take responsibility for technical delivery on agreed priorities, combining new development with day-to-day engineering across existing systems.

Your responsibilities
Technical design: Translate agreed functional requirements into system architecture, data models and implementation plans.

Implementation: Develop and extend software across the following areas:Application functionality: Build user interfaces and implement defined application logic.
AI components: Integrate language models into application features.
Data pipelines: Build data collection and processing pipelines, including web scraping.
System integrations: Integrate applications with enterprise platforms and external business systems.
Task automation: Automate recurring and multi-step tasks through scheduling and orchestration.

Testing: Write and maintain automated tests to verify functionality and catch regressions.
Deployment: Configure cloud environments and deploy application releases.
Maintenance: Diagnose and resolve production issues, and maintain application code, dependencies and cloud infrastructure.

What you bring
Backend development: Strong Python skills and experience building well-structured APIs and services, ideally with FastAPI. Experience implementing external integrations, background tasks and data validation.
Frontend development: Experience with a modern frontend framework, preferably React and TypeScript, covering reusable components, state management, API integration and responsive interfaces.
Architecture and data: The ability to translate functional requirements into pragmatic system designs and relational data models. Strong SQL skills and the ability to extend existing systems without unnecessary complexity.
Applied AI: Practical experience integrating LLMs into applications, using techniques such as retrieval, structured outputs and evaluation. The ability to work across different providers, models and APIs, balancing reliability, latency and cost. Experience with agentic workflows, including tool use and multi-step task orchestration, is a plus.
Data acquisition: Experience collecting data through APIs, web scraping or automated workflows, and turning inconsistent inputs into dependable application data.
Cloud and operations: Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications in Azure or a comparable cloud environment, including configuration, authentication, secrets management, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
Engineering quality: A disciplined approach to testing, version control, documentation and secure, maintainable code, with the ability to investigate and resolve problems across the stack.

Our technology
Our core application stack includes Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, SQL Server and Azure. Our environment also includes Microsoft Graph and SharePoint integrations and a React Native mobile application. Experience with every technology is not required; depth in the core technologies and the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of a working system matter more.

How you work
You plan and prioritize your work independently and see agreed work through to completion.
You communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly, and seek clarification early when business or domain requirements are unclear.
You have strong written and spoken English and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You will help shape architecture and engineering practices, collaborate directly with users, and build and improve applications that support public institutions and responsible AI adoption.

Working hours
Flexible, with a preference for 4–6 of your daily working hours to fall between 08:00 and 22:00 Abu Dhabi time (UTC+4). The exact schedule will be agreed together.

How to apply
To apply, send your CV or LinkedIn profile to contact@regxelerator.com, along with a short note explaining your interest in the role. Please describe one application or system you have worked on that is in active use, highlighting your specific contribution and any involvement in deploying or maintaining it. Links to relevant code, products or case studies are welcome.

For additional information on Regxelerator, visit regxelerator.com.

The opportunity

Unity Studio is our cutting-edge, browser-based real-time 3D authoring tool. Our current focus is on non-gaming use cases, with an ambitious vision to evolve Studio into a universal, web-based collaboration hub for any Unity Project.

As a QA Engineer on the Unity Studio team, you will be embedded in a fast-moving, cross-functional team building the future of web-based 3D creation. You will work hands-on across features, own the testing process end-to-end, and play a key role in helping us ship a high quality product with confidence.

You will collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and product managers from day one. You will have real ownership of the features you test, and the opportunity to shape how quality is approached as the team grows.

What You'll Be Doing

Carry out manual and exploratory testing across features and releases, working within an agile team
Own the QA process for the features you are assigned - from requirements through to sign-off
Write, manage, and maintain test cases and scripts to ensure full scope and coverage
Manage defects throughout their full lifecycle - logging, tracking, escalating, and verifying fixes
Work closely with engineers and product managers to review requirements, surface risks, and produce test plans
Participate in sprint ceremonies including stand-ups, planning, and retrospectives
Collaborate with the broader QA team and all other departments to ship with quality
Contribute to process improvements and help raise the quality bar across the team

What We're Looking For

Good understanding of testing methodologies, test plan organisation, and technical requirements.
Experience writing and executing manual test cases in line with project scope.
Strong experience with QA testing on web or mobile applications.
Experience with defect management and bug tracking tools such as JIRA.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to work to tight deadlines, manage workloads, and escalate where required.
Comfortable collaborating across teams and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You might also have

Experience with the Unity Engine or other interactive 3D tools
Experience in a QA role within the games or interactive media industry
Experience with backend or API testing
Experience building or contributing to automated test procedures
